description: What a WordPress backup leaves out unless the profile says otherwise (docs/PHASE9.md 3.3). Paths are relative to the site root (patterns of ThreadSafe's backup filters; a leading slash anchors a name at the root, so that /wp-content/cache is the cache of the site and not a directory of that name inside a plugin); whole directories, which a restore makes again where WordPress needs them. Tables are named without the prefix and keep only their structure: the ones that hold sessions or logs and nothing a site is made of. The list is short on purpose; what is not on it is kept.
